attackers_goals: Evading detections by running code from a signed Microsoft executable.
description: This unusual parent-child process relationship may indicate that an attacker has abused rundll32.exe to run a console-based application such as PowerShell.
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow.
name: Rundll32.exe spawns conhost.exe
